replay: existing 10 m retained pending staged replay validation

artifactBindings.coordinateConversion: East = origin.east + local X; North = origin.north - local Z; elevation = survey Y; unidentified datum

assumptions.verticalDimensions: Existing visual estimates, not measured construction
assumptions.curbs: Mapped medians/island classified on computational cells; bordering faces are idealized 0.12 m riverwall crests. Face displacement and local convergence are reported. Width is not a resolved hydraulic cross-section.
assumptions.roads: Rendering lift 0.038 m and shading relief excluded
assumptions.infiltration: Zahorra remains hypothetically permeable; no laboratory permeability inferred

maxima.meaning: Physical maxima sampled every 10 s and cell-centre survey elevations; maxima need not occur at the same time

geographicAggregation.method: Native numerical boundary edges assigned by midpoint to fixed geographic 50 m bins
geographicAggregation.limitation: Assigned edge extents change with mesh resolution; regional differences include this discretization as well as hydraulic changes

finestUniformReport.outletFluxNote: 10-second samples of ANUGA native Riemann boundary mass flux, not the solver numerical-flux integral; regional volumes are diagnostics and their mismatch is reported. Global water balance uses the solver-integrated boundary flux.
finestUniformReport.boundaryCondition: Dry exterior at each boundary-edge bed elevation; hypothetical free outfall, no external inflow terrain or downstream stage supplied

numericalFlux.regional: Native DE0 Riemann mass flux sampled at boundary every 10 seconds; checked against integrated global flux

replayDecision.scope: Isolated native terrain + replay, not full game
replayDecision.fullGameValidation: Unavailable after earlier browser automation rejection

limitations: Exploratory uniform hypothetical rainfall; no return period
Unknown downstream terrain, receiver, backwater and external inflows
Survey accuracy and vertical datum unconfirmed
No estimated excavation or construction model
50 m boundary sectors are not constructed drains
Local refinement only supports local sensitivity conclusions
Field maxima and regional peak discharge sampled every 10 seconds; global peak is a 10-second average, not an instantaneous maximum
Full-game browser inspection and callback cadence unavailable after earlier automation rejection; native tests are isolated fixtures

footprintExposure.method: Hydraulic cell centres inside mapped footprints; maximum depth and speed sampled every 10 seconds, not necessarily simultaneously. Area estimates use whole centre-selected cells. Unresolved footprints are null, with no nearest-cell substitution.
limitations: Natural terrain only: building barriers, estimated earthworks, lakes, drainage structures and downstream backwater excluded
The 0.1 m screen is descriptive, not a safety threshold
This result does not establish resident safety or a rainfall return period
